25uint32_t hashLabel(uint64_t label)
26{
27 if (label == 0)
28 return 0x00000000;
29
30 uint32_t seedLow = static_cast<uint32_t>(label & 0xFFFFFFFF);
31 uint32_t seedHigh = static_cast<uint32_t>(label >> 32);
32
33 seedLow = seedLow ^ seedHigh;
34 seedLow = seedLow ^ (seedLow >> 16);
35 seedLow = seedLow * 0x7feb352d;
36 seedLow = seedLow ^ (seedLow >> 15);
37
38 seedHigh = seedHigh ^ seedLow;
39 seedHigh = seedHigh ^ (seedHigh >> 16);
40 seedHigh = seedHigh * 0x85ebca6b;
41 seedHigh = seedHigh ^ (seedHigh >> 13);
42
43 uint32_t r = seedLow & 0xFF;
44 uint32_t g = (seedLow >> 8) & 0xFF;
45 uint32_t b = (seedHigh >> 8) & 0xFF;
46
47 return (r << 0) | (g << 8) | (b << 16) | (0xFF << 24);
48}
